## Evidence Generated issue-sync [#217](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/pull/217), exact head `17d9b32deb98876916e64235f495e7a8b804c49c` on `84b97b6a6c4c91430d41140e93fd7a1699f21006`, adds 22 tracked PM item/history files and edits `CHANGELOG.md` without updating `selfhost.bundle`. The checked source and committed bundle no longer match. This is not a default-branch failure demonstrated here. [Dedicated release gate](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/actions/runs/45000735724/job/137141619059) reports 22 included paths absent from the bundle and differing changelog bytes. [Node 22 quick](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/actions/runs/45000735724/job/137141619276) and [Node 26 coverage](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/actions/runs/45000735724/job/137141619221) independently fail the operational CLI acceptance at `test/exact-gates.test.ts:183–188` on that same parity check. The sync workflow generating the PR succeeded; this is distinct from the old provenance refusal. The [previous native issue-sync repair](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/blob/84b97b6a6c4c91430d41140e93fd7a1699f21006/.agents/pm/issues/pm-vcs-issue-sync-1116.toon) also recorded a stale bundle during its repair and corrected the snapshot by regeneration. ## Acceptance On a sync that changes included tracker paths or the changelog, generate and commit the bundle from the final candidate contents, or leave an explicit failure before presenting a merge-ready candidate. Prefer an idempotent no-op on unchanged input. Verify the final committed tip with `npm run accept:self-host` and the real CLI gate on Node 22 and 26; do not relax byte parity, the path policy, or the existing test coverage requirements. A PM VCS-owned hook may be sufficient; no evidence yet that a central workflow change is required. --- ### GitHub comments (1) > **@coderabbitai[bot]** (2026-11-22T08:32:37Z) > > > > >
